title: ZTIE normalized static-findings document (v1.1)
description: The DERIVED, normalized static-analysis findings document produced by the Story 2.1 static lane (+ the Story 2.2 signature engine) for one intake artifact. ONE shape across all tools (cfn-lint, cfn-guard, checkov, bandit, signature-scan) so Phase 3 correlation consumes a single format. v1.1 (Story 2.2) additively adds: the 'signature-scan' tool + 'signature' check_family, and an OPTIONAL per-finding 'compliance' sub-object mapping the finding to the NIST 800-53 / ISO 27001 control(s) it implicates. NON-EXECUTING: static evidence only, no runtime field. EVIDENCE, NEVER A VERDICT: no verdict/safe/approved/forward field; a compliance mapping says a finding implicates a control, never that the artifact fails. This document STAYS IN FORENSIC (RD-009 — it may echo artifact content); it is written to the Forensic artifact S3 bucket under findings/ and does NOT cross to the Hub. Only a bounded derived summary crosses the RD-013 gate (static-scan-summary.contract.v1), pointing back here. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; arrays + strings bounded so a hostile artifact cannot produce an unbounded document.

contract_version.description: Findings-document schema version. '1.1' (Story 2.2) is the current emitted version; '1.0' (Story 2.1) documents remain valid to read.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this findings document is for.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body the scan ran over. Integrity key bound to intake_id.

artifact_class.description: The class label the scan-tool selection was based on.

scanned_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the scan completed in Forensic.

non_executing.description: Always true. The static lane INSPECTS the artifact; it NEVER executes it (RD-001 — execution is the dynamic lane, 2.3).

tools.description: Per-tool run record: which tools ran, whether each succeeded, and how many findings it produced. A tool 'error' is recorded here and does not crash the lane.

status.description: Whether the tool ran to completion. 'ok' = ran and produced findings (possibly zero); 'error' = the tool failed (crash, timeout, unparsable output). An 'error' does NOT crash the lane — it is recorded here and the other tools still run (production resilience, DoD: 'does not crash on a scanner error').

error_reason.description: Bounded reason when status=error (e.g. 'exit 2', 'timeout', 'unparsable json'). Inert diagnostic text.

findings.description: The normalized findings, one shape across all tools. Bounded so a hostile artifact cannot produce an unbounded document; when a tool produces more than the cap, the excess is dropped and the truncated flag is set (the count in tools[] / the summary remains the true pre-truncation count).

tool.description: Which static tool produced this finding.

rule_id.description: The tool's NATIVE rule / check identifier, verbatim and bounded (e.g. cfn-lint 'E3012', checkov 'CKV_AWS_20', bandit 'B602', a cfn-guard rule name). Kept as-is so a finding is traceable back to the tool's own catalog.

severity.description: The tool's native severity mapped onto ZTIE's normalized ladder. This is a normalized EVIDENCE severity, NOT a verdict.

check_family.description: The kind of check that produced this finding, so Phase 3 can group IaC-lint / policy-as-code / IaC-misconfig / SAST evidence.

message.description: Human-readable description of the finding, bounded. Derived, inert text for triage — never raw executable content.

location.description: Where in the artifact the finding is, when the tool reports it. file is the in-artifact filename; line spans are 1-based.

resource.description: The logical resource / construct the finding is about (e.g. a CloudFormation logical id), when applicable.

guideline.description: Optional bounded pointer to the rule's remediation guidance / docs URL, when the tool provides one. Inert text.

compliance.description: Story 2.2 — the compliance control(s) this finding IMPLICATES, mapped from the finding's tool + native rule_id. NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (catalog of record) + ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A. EVIDENCE, NEVER A VERDICT: a mapping says a finding implicates a control, never that the artifact fails. candidate-vs-ratified (RD-014): basis distinguishes reviewer-ratified from proposed candidate mappings; an unmapped finding carries empty control lists + basis 'unmapped' (ZTIE does not fabricate a control). Bounded: control-id strings short + capped, control lists capped.

nist_800_53.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control ids the finding implicates (e.g. 'SC-28', 'AC-3'). May be empty (unmapped).

iso_27001.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control ids the finding implicates (e.g. 'A.8.24'). May be empty (unmapped).

basis.description: candidate-vs-ratified (RD-014). 'ratified' = an accountable reviewer accepted this mapping; 'proposed' = candidate, authored not yet reviewed; 'unmapped' = no honest mapping (empty lists). ZTIE claims coverage only for ratified mappings.

mapping_version.description: Version of the mapping table that produced this mapping, so a stored finding is traceable to the exact table.

rationale.description: Optional bounded, inert rationale for the mapping (why the finding implicates the control). Present only when mapped.

truncated.description: True iff the findings array was capped (more findings existed than the maxItems bound). The per-tool + summary counts remain true.
